title: Integrate clause obligation registry with production source census and readiness resolvers
description: Follow-up to eshyra-o9bd.19.1.1.3. Integrate the independent source-obligation registry with production source-derived membership/census, family-specific projectors, the authoritative engine capability ledger, and the runtime discovery index. Wire real CapabilityResolver, SourceEvidenceResolver, and DiscoveryResolver implementations and add pack-level conformance coverage. The correction PR intentionally provides only the type-contract boundary and test doubles.
